Conditions and pitfalls Higher-index systems can contain hidden constraints, drift and degraded error control, requiring index reduction or projection formulations. Smaller ODE time steps alone do not fix these issues. Scale tolerances separately for differential and algebraic variables and their units. What to check For an index-1 system with known solution, measure state error, F residual, algebraic-constraint violation and initialization consistency. Vary steps, nonlinear tolerances and initial perturbations; record constraint drift and termination reasons.
